name: Alphastar
note: Version 1.0.65 / build 66 adds built-in Alphastar staff messaging inside Chat with Us, without a Tawk widget or redirect. Clinic staff reply directly from desktop Human Chat. Messages are saved privately, with account-scoped patient access, stable retry references and paged history. Website guests use separate private chat sessions, not email-based patient lookup. The Help Bot transcript and booking details are not automatically shared. Existing Tawk records remain separate and read-only. Updated privacy notices are included. The matching backend and private chat index are required. Physical-phone installation and notification delivery are not verified. Existing development signing certificate retained; not Play Store or production-signing approval.
